name: Space Bar at the End of the Galaxy
source: After a disastrous encounter with the Imperial Fleet, you and your hapless crew manage to trundle into Cicero Lunar Station, in the rogue Tucana Quadrant. With your ship in tatters, your crew seriously judging your ability to lead and your bank account as flat as a pancake, you need to think of something really good to get you and your lot out of the station before the next Imperial Inspection.
translation: 与帝国舰队的一场遭遇战以惨败告终，你和倒霉的船员们好不容易蹒跚抵达法外之地杜鹃座星区的西塞罗月球站。飞船破破烂烂，船员们严重怀疑你的领导能力，银行账户也空空如也。你得想个足够高明的办法，赶在下一次帝国检查之前，带着所有人逃离空间站。
